title: Manage your stand
html:
Here you can view and manage your trade fair stand

Manage your trade fair stand

Here you can with your personal login:

  • View your application details
  • Apply for additional stands during the application period
  • Apply for co-exhibitors during the application period
  • Authorise other users to view and manage your stands or to order services
  • Place service orders during the order period, e.g. electricity and water connections, furniture and parking passes and more
  • View service orders and stands before, during and after the event
